CRUK-styled tooltip

Source: R/crukTooltip.R
crukTooltip.Rd

Wraps a word or phrase in a span (font-weight 600, colour #00007e), appends an info icon after it, and attaches a CRUK-styled bslib::tooltip() to that icon. The tooltip shows on hover/focus (desktop) or tap (touch devices).

Usage

crukTooltip(
  text,
  tip,
  placement = c("bottom", "top", "left", "right"),
  id = NULL
)

Arguments

text

A single string: the word or phrase shown before the icon.

tip

The tooltip content. A string or any htmltools tags.

placement

Where the tooltip appears relative to the icon. One of "bottom" (default), "top", "left" or "right".

id

Optional id passed to bslib::tooltip(), so the tooltip can be controlled from the server with bslib::toggle_tooltip().

Value

An htmltools::tag() with the shinyCRUK tooltip dependency attached.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  library(shiny)
  ui <- bslib::page_fluid(
    shinyCRUK::crukTheme(),
    shiny::p(
      "Here is some ",
      shinyCRUK::crukTooltip("information", "Here is some useful information"),
      " in a sentence."
    )
  )
  shinyApp(ui, function(input, output, session) {})
}
